text:
alex: quick q on soft-tethering for model pins: should rollout metadata include a soft_expiry + an affinity field, or stick to TTL+reason? want something both clients and ops can act on.
maria: +1 soft_expiry. TTLs are too binary. prefer a numeric affinity_priority so resolver sorting is deterministic.
devon: affinity_priority sounds fine. avoid 'score' floats; integers are easier for canary diffs. also surface a small pin_id for tracing.
priya: ops needs origin, issued_by, issued_at, and human_reason to triage. also suggest tenant_scope_closed boolean so control plane knows if per-tenant overrides are allowed.
alex: proposed example metadata (json-like in the thread):
```
pin_type: "soft"
pin_id: "pin-72b"
issued_at: "2025-02-03T16:00:00Z"
soft_expiry: "2025-02-10T16:00:00Z"
affinity_priority: 12
origin: "canary/rollout-42"
issued_by: "autodeploy"
human_reason: "perf regression on variant"
tenant_scope_closed: true
grace_window_ms: 30000
```
devon: also add client-visible guidance: SDKs should degrade score after soft_expiry but not hard-reject unless pin_type=="hard". sample resolver pseudo:
```
now = utc()
for v in variants:
  score = v.base_priority
  if v.pin:
    score += v.pin.affinity_priority
    if v.pin.soft_expiry and now > parse(v.pin.soft_expiry):
      score -= int(v.pin.affinity_priority * 0.7)
choose max score
```
maria: telemetry tags to emit: pin_id, origin, affinity_priority, pin_type, soft_expiry. opsbot: alerting note: when soft_expiry passes and traffic still pinned, emit a warning first, then page if pinned traffic >5% after grace_window.
priya: runbook: on soft_expiry trigger a probe, if >5% continue to page; else create advisory. i'll draft steps.
alex: i'll update RFC with fields + resolver semantics and compatibility guidance for older clients (ignore unknown fields). assigning RFC update to me.
devon: i'll add pin_lifecycle events (created/updated/soft_expired/evicted) and delta events on affinity changes.
maria: minor nit: prefer lower default grace_window_ms if absent; SDKs fallback to 30s.
alex: thanks all, closing after RFC + runbook updates. opsbot: note created: #infra-pin-schema-2025 (auto).
